name: Strong healing draught
description: Deep red and thick as a sermon. The apothecary says it works. The apothecary also says that about everything.
notes: A standard health potion (mw-ju8.4), buy and use only: no brewing yet. Restores 60 health; the minor tier is the existing healing draught at 30. Base value 45 sits in the economy standard potion band. Magnitudes are a placeholder scale for the balance tool.
